releases.name: 3.0.0: one entry point, one reference
releases.notes:
## Install

Minimal package: `opencode-go-model-picker-3.0.0-min.zip` contains only what the skill runs — `SKILL.md`, `references/` (one doc plus two dated seeds), `scripts/` (one entry point + modules) and `LICENSE`. Unzip it into `~/.config/opencode/skills/` so the folder is named `opencode-go-model-picker`. Verify with `node scripts/go.mjs --help` (four verbs: `run` / `report` / `check` / `apply`).

Full notes: [CHANGELOG.md](https://github.com/sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md) · 中文：[CHANGELOG-ZH.md](https://github.com/sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker/blob/main/zh/CHANGELOG-ZH.md)

## [3.0.0] - 2026-11-01

### The size of the simplification

3.0.0 is not a feature release: it is the same job described with **an order of
magnitude less text**. Measured against the 2.0.0 tag:

| What the model must read | 2.0.0 | 3.0.0 | Change |
|---|---|---|---|
| Markdown files | 7 (`SKILL.md` + 6 references) | 2 (`SKILL.md` + `plan-facts.md`) | −5 files |
| Characters | 104,181 | 8,291 | **12.6× smaller** (−92%) |
| Lines | 1,776 | 168 | **10.6× fewer** (−91%) |
| Estimated tokens | ≈27,400 | ≈2,200 | **≈25,200 saved per full read** |
| `SKILL.md` alone | 18,804 chars ≈4,900 tok | 4,221 chars ≈1,100 tok | −78% |
| Runnable entry points | 9 runtime scripts (11 with maintainer tools) | 1 (`go.mjs`) | −8 runtime |
| Minimal install zip | 128,802 B | 89,163 B | −3…

releases.name: v1.2.0
releases.notes:
# v1.2.0

`skill_management` gives every installed OpenCode skill a switch: list what is installed, find out
why one will not load, hide it from the model, and put it back. Disabling writes **one** global
`skill` permission rule — no skill file is ever moved, edited or deleted.

**No breaking changes in 1.2.0.** The four actions, their inputs, the JSON envelope, the written
rule shape, the same-line marker and the single-file layout are unchanged since 1.1.0.

## Fixed since v1.1.0

- **`list` no longer reports "N skills differ across other agents" on every call.**
 `summary.diverged` counted hidden internal agents (`title`, `summary`, …), which carry
 `{*,*,deny}`; on a real machine that made every skill look divergent (33/33) and added a noise
 warning to each `list`. Only **visible** agents are compared now; `inspect.agents[]` still lists
 every agent, so the detail is not lost.
- **Frontmatter booleans no longer contradict each other.** `disable-model-invocation: "false"` is a
 string, and `Boolean("false") === true`, so `inspect` reported it as `true` while `list` reported
 `autoinvoke: false` for the same file. `true/yes/on/1` and `false/no/off/0` (quoted or not) are
 normalized now, and both fields go through the same rule.
- **A failed sidecar write no longer turns a successful config change into an error.** Once the
 config was written and verified, a sidecar write fa…

en.headline: 27 own commits plus 7 automated commits across five repositories
en.summary: **27 own commits** were made across five repositories, plus 7 automated commits by `github-actions[bot]`. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management`, work covered releases `v1.2.0` and `1.2.1`, serialized write enable/disable operations to avoid concurrent overwrites, and made `config_unparsable` reject only the target configuration file. Documentation changes added design-decisions and development pages, expanded Effects to distinguish deny versus ask, moved installation guidance to npm as the recommended channel, and added Chinese release notes for `v1.2.0`. Verification was updated to validate each action output against `OUTPUT_SCHEMA`. In `sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker`, the project moved to a single entry point with four verbs and one reference, removed two test artifacts, and corrected release measurements and size figures. `sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` documentation added minimal verification steps and clarified the roles and source checks of three review commands. `sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` corrected the G2 status, documented the Google 2 key path, and added settings guidance for obtaining that key. In `sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu`, the daily report workflow gained a gate that validates generated artifacts.

releaseNotes.summary: The release consolidates the skill into one entry point with four verbs and one reference. Its minimal package contains `SKILL.md`, `references/`, `scripts/`, and `LICENSE`, and can be verified with `node scripts/go.mjs --help`.

This release keeps the four actions, JSON envelope, permission rule shape, marker, and single-file layout unchanged from `v1.1.0`. It fixes `list` so `summary.diverged` counts visible agents rather than hidden internal agents, removing repeated false divergence warnings.

zh.headline: 27 次本人提交，另有 7 次自动提交，覆盖五个仓库
zh.summary: 当天在五个仓库完成 **27 次本人提交**，另有 7 次由 `github-actions[bot]` 自动提交。`sogeisetsu/opencode-skill-management` 完成 `v1.2.0` 与 `1.2.1` 发布相关工作，将写入启用与禁用操作串行化以避免并发覆盖，并让 `config_unparsable` 只拒绝目标配置文件。文档方面新增 design-decisions 与 development 页面，将 Effects 扩展为 deny 与 ask 之分，把安装页的 npm 提升为推荐通道，并补充 `v1.2.0` 中文发布说明；校验流程也改为按 `OUTPUT_SCHEMA` 检查每个动作的输出。`sogeisetsu/opencode-go-model-picker` 改为单一入口、四个动词和一份参考文档，删除两个测试产物，并修正发布测量值与体积数字。`sogeisetsu/opencode-agent-sandbox` 的文档补充了最小验证步骤，说明三种审查命令的分工与来源核对。`sogeisetsu/sopen-translate` 修正 G2 状态，记录 Google 2 密钥路径，并在设置卡片中说明获取该密钥的方法。`sogeisetsu/sogeisetsu` 的日报 workflow 增加了校验生成物的门禁。

releaseNotes.summary: 该版本将技能整合为单一入口、四个动词和一份参考文档。最小包包含 `SKILL.md`、`references/`、`scripts/` 与 `LICENSE`，可通过 `node scripts/go.mjs --help` 验证。
该版本保持四个动作、JSON 信封、权限规则格式、标记和单文件布局与 `v1.1.0` 一致。它修正了 `list` 的 `summary.diverged` 统计，使其只计算可见代理而非隐藏内部代理，消除反复出现的错误分歧警告。
